_comment: Machine-readable handoff contract for RLinf / IsaacLab. Authoritative prose: ACTION_CONTRACT.md. Do not edit one without the other.
_status: SFT pipeline validated end-to-end; the checkpoint below is a 20-step SMOKE artifact, NOT a trained policy. Replace checkpoint_path after a real SFT run.
checkpoint_path_note: No trained checkpoint exists yet. The 20-step smoke run wrote final_model/pytorch_model.pt (4.2 GB) and it was DELETED afterwards per checkpoint-retention discipline - it had no policy value. A real SFT run writes to <run_dir>/final_model/pytorch_model.pt; set this field then.
degenerate_dims_note: q01 == q99 for these; Normalizer.forward passes them through UNNORMALIZED (raw units). Model output for these dims is already physical, not in [-1,1].
controller_expectation: downstream PD position controller tracks these targets
execution_semantics: predict 30 absolute targets (0.6 s), execute open-loop, then re-plan

navigate_command.note: vx, vy, vyaw; ALL ZERO in this dataset (stationary task)

state_unmapped_note: observation.state[29:63] is 34 tactile channels, IDENTICALLY ZERO in all 45938 frames. Excluded.
task_string: pick up the piston with the right hand, inject it into the tube held by the left hand, then move it over the hole plate.
task_string_note: VERBATIM, single task_index 0, identical across all 67 episodes. RLinf must send this byte-for-byte (lowercase 'pick', trailing period). Any rewording is out-of-distribution.

isaaclab_action_mapping._doc: See ISAACLAB_MAPPING.md for evidence per row.
isaaclab_action_mapping.simulator_action_semantics: JointPositionActionCfg(joint_names=['.*'], scale=1.0, use_default_offset=True) -> offset from default pose
isaaclab_action_mapping.conversion: action_53[art_idx] = starvla_action_30[ds_dim]; identity because every default joint position is 0.0

dropped_ds_dims.26: base_height - no articulation DOF; fixed-base task; constant 0.76 in data
dropped_ds_dims.27: nav_vx - no DOF; exactly 0.0 in all frames
dropped_ds_dims.28: nav_vy - no DOF; exactly 0.0 in all frames
dropped_ds_dims.29: nav_yaw - no DOF; exactly 0.0 in all frames

UNRESOLVED_articulation_indices.reason: Physically coupled to the proximal joints on the real Inspire hand, but ACTCFG actuates all 53 DOFs. No coupling ratio found in the simulator Python sources (would live in the robot USD). Writing 0.0 forces fingers straight while the proximal curls. DO NOT GUESS A RATIO.

isaaclab_camera_mapping.evidence: g1_redball_eval overlay states the dataset ego_view is the D435 color stream at 424x240 and configures front_camera accordingly.

INTRINSICS_MISMATCH.impact: The piston task renders a much wider view than any training frame; the policy would receive out-of-distribution imagery.
INTRINSICS_MISMATCH.fix_location: unitree_sim_isaaclab piston scene cfg (NOT StarVLA). Not applied - outside this task's scope.

dataset_origin: IsaacLab replay of piston CSV trajectories (replay_piston_csv.py); all episodes success=true

server_protocol._note: Per the reference checkpoint README; NOT verified in this pass - no deployment run was performed.
server_protocol.known_issue_RESOLVED: PolicyNormProcessor raised 'Video key ego_view not found in dataset metadata' for data configs with video augmentation (ours has one). Reproduced against this data config, then fixed in deployment/model_server/policy_norm_processor.py (video metadata is now synthesized from data_config.video_keys + obs_image_size). Regression-tested. The reference checkpoint's policy_norm_processor_PATCHED.py drop-in is no longer needed.

unresolved: No closed-loop evaluation was performed. No policy-quality claim is made.

BLOCKING closed-loop: the 12 Inspire intermediate/distal articulation DOFs (39-42,44-47,49-52) have no known coupling ratio. See isaaclab_action_mapping.UNRESOLVED_articulation_indices. Arm motion will be faithful; hand pose fidelity is not guaranteed.
BLOCKING closed-loop: the piston task's front_camera renders 105.5 deg HFOV vs the dataset's 69 deg. Requires a sim-side camera cfg change in unitree_sim_isaaclab (not applied here).
Whether the RLinf/IsaacLab controller requires proprioceptive state input. If yes, wire StateActionDropout before enabling state.
navigate_command and base_height are constant in this dataset, so the policy gets no learning signal for locomotion or torso height. RL must not assume these are controllable from SFT.
Control-rate mismatch: the dataset and this contract are 50 Hz; the IsaacLab piston task runs at 100 Hz (sim.dt 0.005, decimation 2). The deployment loop must resample or re-plan accordingly.
